# JOrbis (third-party)

Pure-Java Ogg Vorbis decoder by ymnk / JCraft, Inc.

- Source: https://github.com/ymnk/jorbis (commit 28592f3dde5134871165470e7390d66ed5f1dce5)
- License: GNU LGPL 2.1 — see `COPYING.LIB`. The sources are shipped unmodified (only the two example programs
  `ChainingExample.java` and `DecodeExample.java` were left out); anyone may rebuild the game with a modified copy.
- Used only to decode `.ogg` files from resource packs or the player's own Minecraft installation at runtime
  (`mc.client.OggDecoder`). No audio files are bundled with this project.
